Insulator, Aqua Blue glass, marked "HEMINGRAY" and "PATENT MAY 2 1893," featuring sharp drip points on the base edge.

The clear insulators show minor surface wear and occasional internal bubbles characteristic of molded utility glass. No significant structural cracks are observed, though minor fleabites consistent with industrial usage may be present along the base edges.

Hemingray Insulator, Aqua Teal Glass, embossed "HEMINGRAY" with beaded drip points - minor base fleabites

description:
Vintage Glass Insulators - 3 Pieces
Pressed Glass, Aqua and Clear
Vintage, Made in U.S.A.
Collection of three vintage glass telephone or telegraph insulators, including one in a classic aqua blue-green and two in clear glass. These heavy industrial artifacts were a staple of early telecommunications infrastructure and have become popular collectibles due to their sculptural forms and light-refracting properties.
Pieces Included:
Aqua glass insulator, approximately 4 inches tall, beaded drip edge base, marked "MADE IN U.S.A."
Clear glass insulator, approximately 4 inches tall, beaded drip edge base, marked "MADE IN U.S.A."
Clear glass insulator, approximately 4 inches tall, smooth base rim, marked "MADE IN U.S.A."
Condition:
Overall good vintage condition. All pieces show internal rust staining and surface accumulation within the threaded centers from former utility use. The glass remains structurally sound without major cracks. Minor fleabites, surface scuffs, or small chips common to salvaged glass insulators may be present. All markings are molded into the glass.
Warehouse Location: Cleveland
Due to our lighting, white glare lines may appear on items - This is NOT damage

Polished Agate and Amethyst Specimens - Brazil Origin

description:
Hemingray Glass Company
No. 45 Glass Insulator
Pressed Glass, Clear, Vintage
A classic piece of American industrial history, this Hemingray No. 45 glass insulator was a standard component for telegraph and telephone lines during the 20th century. These insulators are sought after by collectors for their sculptural form and historical significance in the expansion of communication infrastructure. The No. 45 model features a robust double-petticoat design intended for high-performance electrical isolation.
Double petticoat construction for electrical insulation integrity
Clear glass with a subtle light aqua tint characteristic of period glass production
Embossed "HEMINGRAY - 45" marking prominently on the lower base skirt
Approximately 3.75 inch base diameter and 4 inch total height
Condition:
Excellent vintage condition with no major chips or structural cracks. Inner and outer petticoats are intact. Original gloss is well-preserved with minor surface scratches consistent with age and utility service. Threaded core is clean and undamaged.

description:
Product Overview:
This lot contains a variety of mineral and rock specimens featuring diverse colors, patterns, and formations. Included are an amethyst geode with a purple crystal cluster and central cavity, a blue agate geode half, a heart-shaped clear quartz, a polished slice of brown and tan jasper, a rough piece of petrified wood, a blue celestite crystal cluster, a brown septarian nodule with visible crystal formations, and a pinkish-tan granite or rhyolite specimen.

Specifications:
- Amethyst geode: purple crystals with central cavity
- Blue agate geode half
- Heart-shaped clear quartz
- Polished slice of brown and tan jasper
- Rough petrified wood piece
- Blue celestite crystal cluster
- Brown septarian nodule with crystal formation
- Pinkish-tan granite or rhyolite specimen

All specimens are in natural, unmounted condition with some rough edges, chips, and natural matrix present.

The items are from the same Goodwill location.

You have not already paid for any of the items.

Items are not already in a fixed-price, flat-rate shipping box.

PLEASE NOTE: electronics, glass, and other fragile items do not qualify for combined shipping.
Refused/Unclaimed Packages:
If an item is returned as unclaimed or not deliverable, we will contact the customer at the email address listed on their ShopGoodwill.com account to notify them of the return. The customer will then have seven (7) days to pay additional shipping charges for the item to be resent. If we have not received payment within those seven (7) days, the item will be relisted and prior payment will be considered a charitable contribution.

Please let us know if third-party shipping is arranged by sending us an email to release the item to the third-party shipper. Thank you and please let us know if we can assist further!

description:
Glo Minerals & Glo Skin Beauty
Pressed Base Powder Foundation Lot
Assorted Shades, 4 Pieces
This lot includes four compacts of Pressed Base powder foundation from Glo Skin Beauty, featuring both current branding and the previous Glo Minerals aesthetic. Renowned in the professional skincare industry, Glo foundations are formulated with triple-milled minerals and antioxidant-rich ingredients like Green Tea and Vitamin E to provide buildable coverage with a natural, skin-like finish.
Four distinct shades included: Natural Fair, Natural Medium, Golden Light, and Natural Dark
Mixed net weights: Two compacts at 0.35 oz (9.9g) and two at 0.31 oz (9g)
Includes original retail boxes for all four compacts
Professional-grade mineral makeup for varied skin tones
Condition:
The outer cardboard boxes show visible shelf wear, including scuffing to the black finish, edge rubbing, and minor corner denting. The compacts themselves are intact. The powder surfaces appear smooth and unused in provided images. All base labels are present and fully legible.
THANK YOU FOR YOUR PURCHASE!
If you’re happy and you know it, please leave a 5-star rating! If there is a problem with your order, please contact us via Shop Goodwill before opening returns/claims. We strive to return all messages within one business day.
Please click the shipping estimate link in the listing to get the shipping costs directly from FedEx.  There will be no discounts or price changes after an auction has ended.
Our shipping team works hard to get out all orders as quickly as possible, that being said it may take up to 5 business days after payment for your order to ship out.  Once it ships out you will receive tracking information.
***IMPORTANT*** If your item was damaged in transit, do not throw away anything, including the box or packing materials until we have authorized you to do so. Photos will be required to file insurance claims.
Our Business hours: Monday - Friday  8:00 am to 4:00 pm Central

This lot includes 24 assorted collectible mineral and gemstone specimens. The collection features a variety of polished and raw stones such as amethyst clusters, tumbled stones including possible obsidian, jasper, rose quartz, dalmatian stone, and opalite. Also included are raw green fluorite, a selenite wand, desert rose gypsum, and other mineral specimens. The lot contains two wire-wrapped gemstone trees suitable for decorative or metaphysical uses. The stones vary in size, shape, and color, with hues ranging from deep purples and blacks to greens, whites, and browns. All items are in good, used condition, suitable for collectors, educational purposes, or crystal enthusiasts.

Due to volume, we cannot answer detailed questions about individual pieces within a lot.
Lots are non-refundable and cannot be combined with other purchases.
Authentication
Signatures and autographs are not authenticated unless specified.
Name brand items are not authenticated unless listed as Certified Authentic.
Certified items are authenticated through AuthenticateFirst.com and include a certificate in compliance with ShopGoodwill’s brand policy.
Electronics & Clocks
